# Which snow plow contract pays you the most per hour: per push, per inch or seasonal?

> Compare per-push, seasonal flat, capped and hybrid snow plow contracts across low, normal and high snow years, with break-even storms and a walk-away price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
